title: PartCAD Assembly YAML (ASSY)
description: The schema of an Assembly YAML document, as it looks *after* the file has been rendered as a Jinja2 template. See docs/source/assy.rst.

OCCTLocation.description: An OCCT location: [[x, y, z], [axis-x, axis-y, axis-z], angle].

params.description: Parameter values passed to the referenced part, assembly or interface.

exploded.description: The gap, in millimeters, to show between the two items in the exploded view of this step of the assembly instruction book. Does not affect the assembly itself.

comment.description: Free-form context about this connection, for a human or an LLM reading the assembly. Nothing in PartCAD parses it or acts upon it: every instruction needed to perform the assembly belongs in the other fields.

holdInterfaces.description: An interface to hold an object by, or the list of them.

how.description: How the object is expected to be brought into place. Every field is optional; an omitted one means its documented default. See docs/source/assy.rst.

stage.description: The name of the group of steps performed at the same time. A label, so a bare number is accepted and read as one.

pushForceMax.description: The maximum linear force to push the object into place with, in newtons (N). Default: 5.

pushTorqueMax.description: Deprecated: the earlier spelling of "pushForceMax". Still accepted, with a warning.

pushDistance.description: How far back along the push direction the object starts, in millimeters. Derived from the object being connected when omitted.

turnDirection.description: Which way the object is turned while it is brought into place: "cw" (clockwise) or "ccw" (counterclockwise), in any case. Default: "cw".

turnTorqueMax.description: The maximum torque to turn the object with, in newton-metres (N*m). Default: 0.

threadStep.description: The axial distance the object advances per full turn, in millimeters. Inherited from the interfaces being connected when omitted.

selfScrew.description: Whether this joint cuts its own thread - an ordinary screw driven into soft material, which forms a thread there that neither part declares. The two solids occupy the same space where that thread is formed, so the interference is expected rather than reported. Says it of this one joint: an interface says it of everywhere it is used, and a mating of the pair. Only meaningful where the joint is turned, so it requires 'turnTorqueMax'.

snapIn.description: Whether this joint is made by pushing one part past a feature on the other that springs back behind it - a clip, a barb, a detent. Getting past means the two solids pass through each other, and a model that holds no springs holds them overlapping, so the interference is expected rather than reported. Turned or not, but never alongside 'selfScrew': a joint is snapped together or threaded into place, not both.

interferes.description: The other items this one also ends up sharing space with as this connection is made. A screw driven into one part carries on through the next and cuts its thread in that one too: the connection is to one of them, but the interference is with all of them, and only the connection knows. Named the way an item is named in this assembly; a name matches an item whose own name ends with it, so 'shaft' covers 'gearbox/shaft'.

connect.description: Placement by mating an interface of this object with an interface of an object already in the assembly.

connectPorts.description: Placement by matching a port of this object with a port of an object already in the assembly.

node.description: A node of the assembly tree: a reference to a part, a reference to an assembly, or a container of other nodes.

description.description: Free-form text about this node: the item it places, or the sub-assembly a container node declares. Shown in the assembly's generated documents; nothing in PartCAD parses it or acts upon it.
